motionRules.transition: shared-world camera spline; no fade-to-black or hard pop-in
motionRules.camera: each scene exits by dolly/orbit through the next scene's anchor
motionRules.text: kinetic labels attached to world objects; one claim per shot
motionRules.ui: browser panels float on tracked planes; cursor and button state are animated
motionRules.qwen: optional 1.2-1.6s concept bridge only; never used as calculation evidence

scenes.title: AI ENGINEER
scenes.claim: 从一句需求，到可交付方案
scenes.visual: WaterPro-style dawn ocean; drone skims wave crest, dives toward a floating wind turbine; Gaussian mist reveals a clean native model
scenes.camera: 24mm aerial push-in → low orbit around platform → match-cut on tower highlight
scenes.voice: 复杂工程，往往不是缺少算法，而是需求、模型和证据彼此断开。

scenes.title: 一句话，变成任务图
scenes.claim: 语言 → 结构化工程输入
scenes.visual: Live AI Engineer web capture; type ‘20 MW 浮式风机 / 深海 / 质量约束’, cursor clicks Run; typed tokens fly into an orbiting task graph
scenes.camera: tower highlight becomes UI cursor trail; 3D plane rotates into full browser frame, then pushes through the Run button
scenes.voice: AI Engineer，把它们接成一条可以运行的链路。你输入目标、海况和约束，系统把语言拆成几何、网格、材料和载荷。

scenes.title: 让材料沿着力留下
scenes.claim: BESO 迭代，保留有效路径
scenes.visual: Native VTK mesh explodes into voxels; 44 state thumbnails flow along a ribbon; low-contribution cells dissolve, load paths glow teal; final skeleton reassembles
scenes.camera: macro fly-through one cell → spiral pull-back to full mesh → snap to final skeleton
scenes.voice: 设计域生成后，BESO 沿着受力路径增减材料，四十四个状态实时留下轨迹。

scenes.title: 把结构放进真实环境
scenes.claim: 风、浪与系泊，绑定到同一个模型
scenes.visual: WaterPro-style layered waves; platform heave/pitch follows controlled response; camera dives below surface to show moorings and flow vectors; Zwind chart is pinned to tower base
scenes.camera: surface orbit → underwater dive → cable-following dolly → rise to tower-top response dot
onScreen: 纵荡 · 纵摇 · 系泊
scenes.voice: 结构成形，不等于设计完成。把它放进风浪场，Z，风回放一百二十秒响应，纵荡、纵摇和系泊张力都绑定到模型。

scenes.title: 改一个参数，整条链路响应
scenes.claim: 交互、计算、记录同步发生
scenes.visual: Real browser capture on a tracked glass plane; mass ratio slider moves 0.25→0.30; Run button pulses; queue, iteration counter and chart update; keep label ‘saved run playback’ if not a live solve
scenes.camera: push through chart line into browser plane; parallax across tabs; exit through download icon
scenes.voice: 网页里改一次质量比，任务重新排队，参数、日志和结果一起归档。

scenes.title: 模型、仿真、报告
scenes.claim: 同一份证据，贯穿每个工具
scenes.visual: Hero model becomes a clean Blender/Lux3D turntable; wireframe overlays Three.js scene; three tool nodes orbit and connect to a single evidence spine; optional Qwen concept bridge as a 1.4s Gaussian splash
scenes.camera: dolly through model surface → wireframe tunnel → orbit around three nodes → land on report thumbnail
scenes.voice: 拓扑骨架重建成构件，再交给 Three.js、Blender 和报告模板；模型、仿真、报告，共用一条证据链。

scenes.title: 结果，必须能对照
scenes.visual: Two turbine silhouettes share one baseline; metric ribbon animates 278 → 255.5 t/MW; 8.1% reduction appears as a single large kinetic number; small source tag stays in margin
scenes.camera: report page folds into 3D metric ribbon; lateral track across bars; end on highlighted 255.5
scenes.voice: 论文案例里，单位功率用钢量由二百七十八降到二百五十五点五吨，约降百分之八点一。数字之外，每一步都能回看、复算、追责。

scenes.title: AI ENGINEER
scenes.visual: Metric ribbon becomes the tower's structural spine; completed turbine rises above horizon; tiny workflow chips collapse into the wordmark; ZJU logo remains right-top
scenes.camera: slow crane-up from tower base to horizon; 50mm compression; final 1.2s hold with subtle parallax, no fade
onScreen: 需求 → 模型 → 仿真 → 证据
scenes.voice: 这就是 AI Engineer：让智能负责衔接，让工程计算负责验证，让设计带着证据交付。
